The '''Crystal Flats''' was a large expanse of [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] rock on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. The northern portion of the area was covered with [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] formed from mineral deposits in the [[Magma/Legends|lava]], giving the entire region its name.

The Crystal Flats were known to be the home to a particularly aggressive subspecies of Mustafar [[Lava flea/Legends|lava flea]]. The area was also a location in which members of the [[Blackguard (Mustafar)/Legends|Blackguard]] collected crystals for their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Crystal Flats appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Crystal Flats were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:CF" />
